primary_task: Determine whether a given audio, image or video at a public URL is AI-generated by submitting it to the Resemble AI POST /detect API and reporting the completed label and score.

requirements.name: RESEMBLE_API_KEY
requirements.evidence: compatibility: 'Requires a Resemble AI API key (https://app.resemble.ai) set as RESEMBLE_API_KEY.' ... **API Key**: Bearer token from the Resemble AI dashboard (set as `RESEMBLE_API_KEY`)
requirements.basis: lacks: "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)"

requirements.name: app.resemble.ai
requirements.basis: description: "Network egress goes through an allow-list proxy: the package registries and hosts pypi (PyPI), npm, GitHub (github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com), Ubuntu (apt archives), NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused"; app.resemble.ai is not in egress_allow

requirements.name: Resemble MCP server
requirements.evidence: When the Resemble MCP server is connected, use these tools instead of raw API calls
requirements.basis: lacks: "connectors or integrations other than the tools listed"

requirements.name: media at a public HTTPS URL
requirements.evidence: **Media Requirement**: All media must be at a publicly accessible HTTPS URL
requirements.basis: The manifest does not cover user-supplied media; the user must provide the URL.

notes: The Iron Law forbids declaring media real or fake without a completed Resemble detect job, so the agent cannot substitute its own judgment. The MCP server is an optional alternative to raw API calls and is also missing. Text detection still needs the same API and key, so no reading is achievable.
